ns2:section.sectionText: Environmental Education Field Experience will introduce students to the thinking process required for developing high quality environmental education activities and provide practice designing and implementing them. The field experience for this course will take two forms, leading an Environmental Science after school club at Booker T. Washington Elementary School once a week for eight weeks (February 19-April 16) and delivering an environmental education activity on Friday and Saturday of ExploreACES (March 8 and 9). There is no fee for this section of NRES 285.
